verifications.claim: The 2026 National Cherry Blossom Festival in Washington, D.C. runs from March 20 to April 12.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The National Cherry Blossom Festival (March 20 – April 12, 2026)
verifications.reasoning: R7 directly states the exact dates for the 2026 festival.

verifications.claim: The 2026 National Cherry Blossom Festival's peak bloom occurs on March 26.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: Peak bloom of the cherry blossoms began on March 26 according to the National Park Service (R5); peak bloom occurred on March 26, 2026 (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm cherry blossom peak bloom on March 26, 2026, during the festival, but do not attribute 'peak bloom' directly to the festival itself.

verifications.claim: The Yoshino trees at the Tidal Basin are currently in full, puffy white bloom.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: puffy white blossoms wrapped the shoreline. With more than 70% of the blooms open (R1); Stage Five, known as Puffy White, into full bloom (R8); puffy-white stage on March 22, peak bloom on March 26 (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe Yoshino trees at Tidal Basin reaching puffy white stage before peak (70% open, full bloom), but 'currently' and 'full, puffy white' mixes stages imprecisely.

verifications.claim: The National Park Service confirmed peak bloom on March 26, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Peak bloom of the cherry blossoms began on March 26 according to the National Park Service (R5); Peak bloom has arrived... Posted March 26, 2026 (R8); peak bloom actually arrived on March 26 (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly attribute NPS confirmation of peak bloom on March 26, 2026.

verifications.claim: Prime viewing spots include the Tidal Basin, East Potomac Park, and the National Arboretum.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: The best places to see cherry blossoms in DC include the Tidal Basin... East Potomac Park... U.S. National Arboretum (R2); majority... at the Tidal Basin... shoreline of East Potomac Park... National Arboretum (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly list these as prime/top viewing spots.

verifications.claim: Other locations include East Potomac Park, The Wharf, and the U.S. National Arboretum.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: East Potomac Park... U.S. National Arboretum (R2); The Wharf neighborhood... facing dozens of cherry trees along the water... East Potomac Park (R4)
verifications.reasoning: East Potomac Park and National Arboretum listed as locations; Wharf described as viewing spot facing trees, not direct blossom location.

verifications.claim: The National Cherry Blossom Festival Parade is held during the festival period.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: the National Cherry Blossom Festival Parade® presented by Events DC... National Cherry Blossom Festival (March 20 – April 12, 2026)
verifications.reasoning: R7 confirms the parade as a signature event during the festival dates.

verifications.claim: According to WTOP, the flowers are expected to remain on the trees for several days, depending on weather conditions.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: No mention of petals remaining for several days or weather-dependent duration in R1 (WTOP article)
verifications.reasoning: R1 (WTOP) does not state this; other sources discuss duration generically, but claim specifically attributes unsupported info to WTOP.
